title: scp.pattern_bundle.v0
description: INTERIM antigen bundle format owned by SCP-ANT1 (design artifact, not runtime). A versioned, signed bundle of ABSTRACTED threat patterns for decentralized exchange over nostr announcements + content-addressed HTTPS payloads. Interim until SCP-R1 defines the semantic-field SSOT; on R1 landing, bump schema_revision and migrate inner payload fields.

manifest.description: Billable / signable unit. Safe for public free tier (hash + summary + taxonomy only). The issuer_pubkey is the publisher's nostr identity key (Schnorr/secp256k1); the same key signs the nostr announcement event.

schema_revision.description: Interim revision tag. Bump when SCP-R1 semantic schema becomes SSOT.

antigen_id.description: Stable identity; maps to the nostr addressable-event 'd' tag for versioned replacement.

bundle_version.description: Monotonic; bump on any pattern semantic change (spec 2.2).

issuer_pubkey.description: Issuer nostr/secp256k1 public key (hex 64 chars or bech32 npub).

expires_at.description: Optional staleness/expiry hint for consumers (spec 0.3 outage row).

payload_content_hash.description: Content address of the full payload. Verified out-of-band against the HTTPS-fetched body. Its 64-hex digest (without the 'sha256:' prefix) equals the nostr announcement 'x' tag (NIP-94-style bare hex).

payload_format.description: Wire format of the fetched payload before parsing.

payload_urls.description: One or more content-addressed HTTPS locations (mirrors). A relay/mirror cannot forge content because payload_content_hash is verified independently. L402-gated URLs allowed (P1+).

free_tier_summary.description: Short, NON-EXECUTABLE human summary safe for public broadcast. No payloads, no raw incident text.

risk_tags.description: Low-cardinality taxonomy labels only (e.g. 'injection', 'reversal', 'jailbreak'). No attack specifics.

signature.description: OPTIONAL at-rest issuer signature over the canonicalized manifest (excluding this field), Schnorr/secp256k1 to reuse the nostr identity. Optional because the nostr announcement event signature already authenticates the issuer; recommended when bundles are exchanged off-relay. The §11.4 'invalid signature -> auto-reject' rule applies when a signature is present or required by operator policy.

cosignatures.description: Optional reviewer/notary co-signatures (trust mechanism, spec 5). Each is an independent attestation; presence does NOT imply safety.

payload.description: Full antigen body. ABSTRACTED, normalized threat patterns only. By default MUST NOT contain raw victim prompts, chat logs, PII, or reproducible cognitohazard bodies (spec 6.1, D invariant). Fetched over HTTPS, verified against manifest.payload_content_hash, then quarantined before any merge.

patterns.description: Pattern entries aligned with the FUTURE SCP-R1 schema. Field names here are interim and owned by ANT1 until R1 lands.

category.description: SCP tier/category, e.g. injection, reversal, jailbreak, hostile_ux. Taxonomy, not a raw exploit.

detector.description: Normalized, non-executable detection descriptor (e.g. token/regex family, semantic-alias class). Must be a defensive signature, not a working attack string.

normalized.description: Abstracted form (e.g. masked/normalized), never a literal reproducible payload.

containment.description: Recommended SCP containment action (e.g. sanitize, quarantine, block). Advisory only; operator policy decides.

notes.description: Optional defensive notes. No raw hazardous bodies.
